prompt: A booking-product hero can show a synthetic-data screen with a clear workflow; do not fabricate recognizable customer records or imply a concept is a shipped feature. Give a read-only recommendation; do not touch live systems.
rubric: Choose real product captures, designed graphics or generated illustration by the communication goal. Define composition, focal point, copy-safe area and visual proof before choosing a tool. Preserve accurate product UI and label conceptual mockups. Prepare variations for aspect ratios without automatic cropping of essential information.

Inspect the actual output for legibility, artifacts, faithful UI, contrast, safe areas and rights. Export suitable dimensions/formats and check file size and alt-text needs.

If evidence is incomplete, state exactly which conclusion cannot be supported and what observation would resolve it. Check for instrumentation faults, cohort selection, seasonality and delayed outcomes before attributing a change to an intervention. Keep unrelated workflows unloaded.
Preserve authorization and relevant privacy/security boundaries.
